title: Annual General Meeting Minutes - October 2025
excerpt: Annual General Meeting held on October 13, 2025, covering the President's Report, Treasurer's Report, 2026 committee elections, tipping competition results, and major raffle winners.

textItems.title: Capital Tigers AGM Details
textItems.paragraph:
Date: 13th October, 2025
Meeting started: 7:33pm
Meeting ended: 8:24pm
Venue: Eastlakes FC, Kingston ACT
Attendees: Raylene Easton, Cherie Roe, Jenni Shoring, Tony Allocca, Michael Dacoster, Rod Powell, Rhiannon Powell, Rowan Powell, Tony Watt, Benjamin Waller, George Easton
Apologies: Paul Simper

Previous Minutes:
2024 AGM Minutes read and accepted - Moved by Cherie, Seconded by Raylene.

textItems.title: President's Report - Raylene Easton
textItems.paragraph:
President Raylene Easton welcomed members and acknowledged 2025 as a challenging year for both Richmond FC and Capital Tigers. Key points included:
- Game day attendance at Eastlakes was lower than previous years, though core supporters remained dedicated
- Unable to organize Sydney bus trip for GWS game - apologies to disappointed members
- Special recognition of treasurer Cherie Roe's 9 years of exceptional service
- Welcome to new committee members Ben Waller (website designer) and Jenni Shoring (secretary)
- Thanks to VP Tony Allocca and Liam Pickering (tipping competition coordinator)
- Richmond FC liaison change: Marcus Crocitti replaced by Cameron Cripps
- Personal health update and thanks for member support
- Optimism for future success remembering premierships in 2017, 2019, and 2020

textItems.title: Treasurer's Report - Cherie Roe
textItems.paragraph: Treasurer Cherie Roe presented the 2025 financial report. Following the report, President Raylene Easton thanked Cherie for her amazing work as treasurer over the past 9 years, acknowledging her valuable contributions to the committee. Cherie reciprocated by thanking Raylene for stepping up as president and leading both the committee and wider Capital Tigers membership.

textItems.title: 2026 Committee Elections
textItems.paragraph:
Returning Officer George Easton conducted the elections with all positions declared vacant:

Executive Positions:
- President: Raylene Easton (elected unopposed)
- Vice President: Tony Allocca (elected unopposed)
- Secretary: Jenni Shoring (elected unopposed)
- Treasurer: Position vacant - to be advertised (interim handover with Tony & Jenni)

General Committee Members elected:
- Paul Simper
- Benjamin Waller
- Rod Powell
- Rhiannon Powell
- Liam Pickering (to be confirmed)

textItems.title: Tipping Competition Winners
textItems.paragraph:
2025 Tipping Competition Results:
- Knockout Winner: Liam Pickering

Weekly Tipping Prize Winners:
- Rob Delitz: $105
- Tony Watt: $90
- Craig Hammond: $20
- Greg Watt: $20
- Andrew Murray: $5

textItems.title: Major Raffle Draw Results
textItems.paragraph:
2025 Major Raffle Winners:
- 1st Prize (2025 Signed Guernsey): Jan Headon
- 2nd Prize (Signed Sherrin Ball): Liam French
- 3rd Prize (2024 Signed Guernsey): Jim Aravanis

Congratulations to all winners!

textItems.title: Financial Contribution to Richmond FC
textItems.paragraph:
The committee discussed the annual contribution to Richmond FC. A motion was passed to contribute $500 while ensuring the club retains sufficient funds for early 2026 activities including a Bunnings BBQ fundraiser and potential bus trip deposit. The committee aims to increase contributions in 2026 with more active fundraising.

Motion: $500 contribution to Richmond FC
Moved by: Jenni Shoring
Seconded by: Raylene Easton
Result: Carried
